description: A special root-level Next.js file used to bootstrap server-side observability SDKs and register global request error hooks across Node.js and Edge runtimes.
An exported function in instrumentation.ts invoked once per server instance startup to initialize OpenTelemetry tracers, metrics exporters, or runtime-specific monitoring agents.
An environment variable set by Next.js to 'nodejs' or 'edge', used inside register() to conditionally import runtime-compatible telemetry libraries.
An instrumentation hook triggered on any uncaught server error across RSC rendering, Route Handlers, Server Actions, or Middleware, providing the error digest, request metadata, and route context.
A deterministic hash attached to server errors (err.digest) that is safe to expose to client error.tsx boundaries while linking directly to the full stack trace captured by onRequestError.
